description:
Apply the workspace extras-preservation policy (JMAP-lbdy) to crate-jmap-calendars-types.

In scope (estimate ~25 public wire-shaped Deserialize structs):
- Calendar, CalendarRights, IncludeInAvailability
- CalendarEvent
- ParticipantIdentity
- CalendarEventNotification, Person
- BusyPeriod (availability)
- jscalendar.rs typed sub-types (14 types): Location, VirtualLocation, Link, Relation, Participant, RecurrenceRule, NDay, Alert, OffsetTrigger, AbsoluteTrigger, LocalDateTime, Duration, SignedDuration. AlertTrigger is an enum with an Unknown(Value) variant — review whether enum variants need extras (probably not for tagged enums, yes for struct variants).
- Capabilities structs

Out of scope:
- Filter / Comparator algebra (CalendarFilterCondition, CalendarEventFilterCondition, CalendarEventComparator, NotificationFilterCondition).
- Property selector enums.
- Module-internal helpers.

Coordination: this is the reference implementation's jscalendar.rs. The shape established here will be mirrored by jmap-tasks-types per JMAP-yfpq, and propagated to every extension-types sibling per the canonical-template rule in workspace AGENTS.md.

Acceptance: every in-scope struct has `pub extra: Map<String, Value>` with the documented attributes; one round-trip preservation test per type; PLAN.md updated; cargo test/clippy/fmt clean.
title: Adopt extras policy in jmap-calendars-types
